title: Cahn-Hilliard dynamical models for condensed biomolecular systems.
authors: Groves, Sarah M; Lu, Min-Jhe; Alvarez-Yela, Astrid Catalina; Gerardo-Ramirez, Monserrat; Stukenberg, P Todd; Lowengrub, John S; Janes, Kevin A
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文用Cahn-Hilliard方程模拟生物分子凝聚体的相分离动力学，并以染色体乘客复合物为例验证，虽未直接建模IDR介导的PPI，但为凝聚体动态机制提供了可迁移的物理建模框架。
abstract: Biomolecular condensates create dynamic subcellular compartments that alter systems-level properties of the networks surrounding them. One model combining soluble and condensed states is the Cahn-Hilliard equation, which specifies a diffuse interface between the two phases. Customized approaches required to solve this equation are largely inaccessible. Using two complementary numerical strategies, we built stable, self-consistent Cahn-Hilliard solvers in Python, MATLAB, and Julia. The algorithms simulated the complete time evolution of condensed droplets as they dissolved or persisted, relating critical droplet size to a coefficient for the diffuse interface in the Cahn-Hilliard equation. We applied this universal relationship to the chromosomal passenger complex, a multi-protein assembly that reportedly condenses on mitotic chromosomes. The fully constrained Cahn-Hilliard simulations yielded dewetting and coarsening behaviors that closely mirrored experiments in different cell types. The Cahn-Hilliard equation tests whether condensate dynamics behave as a phase-separated liquid, and its numerical solutions advance generalized modeling of biomolecular systems.
abstract_zh: 生物分子凝聚体（biomolecular condensates）形成动态的亚细胞区室，改变其周围网络的系统级特性。一种结合可溶态与凝聚态的模型是Cahn-Hilliard方程，该方程描述了两相之间的弥散界面。求解此方程所需的定制化方法在很大程度上难以获得。利用两种互补的数值策略，我们在Python、MATLAB和Julia中构建了稳定且自洽的Cahn-Hilliard求解器。这些算法模拟了凝聚液滴在溶解或持续存在过程中的完整时间演化，将临界液滴尺寸与Cahn-Hilliard方程中弥散界面的系数联系起来。我们将这一普适关系应用于染色体乘客复合物（chromosomal passenger complex），这是一种据报道在有丝分裂染色体上凝聚的多蛋白组装体。完全约束的Cahn-Hilliard模拟产生了去湿和粗化行为，与不同细胞类型中的实验密切吻合。Cahn-Hilliard方程检验凝聚体动力学是否表现为相分离液体，其数值解推进了生物分子系统的广义建模。
